_doc: UI-test av Kartrummets steg Biomes (tools/studio/ui_test.py): vyn, andelarna, penseln (ett riktigt musdrag), Spara med det målade lagret, ladda tillbaka och sudda. Sparar världen ui_test_biomes i assets/terrain/; ta bort den efteråt.
name: biomes

steps.label: the Biomes step opens with the biome view

steps.expect: (() => { const w = __studio.terrain.weights; let bad = 0; for (let k = 0; k < w.length; k += 8 * 997) { let s = 0; for (let b = 0; b < 8; b++) s += w[k + b]; if (Math.abs(s - 255) > 8) bad++; } return bad === 0; })()
steps.label: every corner's biome weights add up to 1
the footer shows the biome shares
the drawer has the eight biomes and Erase

steps.eval: (() => { const w = __studio.terrain.weights; let s = 0; for (let k = 2; k < w.length; k += 8) s += w[k]; window.__forest0 = s / (w.length / 8) / 255; return window.__forest0; })()

steps.label: with a brush the left button paints instead of turning

steps.eval: (() => { const w = __studio.terrain.weights; let s = 0; for (let k = 2; k < w.length; k += 8) s += w[k]; window.__forest1 = s / (w.length / 8) / 255; return window.__forest1; })()

steps.label: Save stores the painted layer with the recipe

steps.eval: (() => { const w = __studio.terrain.weights; let s = 0; for (let k = 2; k < w.length; k += 8) s += w[k]; return s / (w.length / 8) / 255; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const w = __studio.terrain.weights; let s = 0; for (let k = 2; k < w.length; k += 8) s += w[k]; return Math.abs(s / (w.length / 8) / 255 - window.__forest0) < 0.0005; })()
steps.label: Clear all painting gives the rules back

steps.expect: (() => { const w = __studio.terrain.weights; let s = 0; for (let k = 2; k < w.length; k += 8) s += w[k]; return Math.abs(s / (w.length / 8) / 255 - window.__forest1) < 0.001; })()
